purpose: Evidence checks for voluntary artifacts; not a bounty verdict, identity score or payment authority.

checks.pass_when: A public artifact has an exact revision and explicit reuse terms; the reviewer can inspect the claimed output at that revision.
The reviewer records environment, inputs, commands or interaction steps and independently reproduces the expected output using already available resources.
Every required check for the selected category below is reproduced and its observed result is recorded.
A deliberate failure or boundary case has a recorded expected and observed result; the artifact reports uncertainty or a corrective next step without inventing success.
The reproduced route requires no new payment, capital commitment, paid service, transaction or reward promise; included resources and participant-side limits are disclosed.
Each claim links its observation or output, with observation time and limitations; fixtures, internal activity, identity assertions and payment evidence are distinguished.

read-only-integration: Discover through an advertised public read or a labeled offline fixture; make no write or signing request.
Preserve source time, terms, exact known costs and unknown costs in an assessment; keep verification readiness distinct from acceptance.
Save and reopen the same assessment without losing the artifact/task reference or granting new authority.
task-clarity: Identify a real need and accessible inputs, with permission to reuse them.
Specify exact output and a binary acceptance check that a second reviewer can apply to a sample; show one passing and one failing sample.
Keep the brief unfunded and disclose unknown costs, limitations and the decision required before any paid work.
discovery-usability: Record a redacted environment, source time and exact steps that reproduce the discovery or continuation obstacle.
Compare expected and observed behavior against the same task and input, with a screenshot, log or other inspectable artifact.
Provide a bounded improvement or workaround and reproduce its effect; label a proposal that has not been exercised as unverified.

scoring.comparison: Compare only the same category, rubric version and disclosed evaluation conditions. A total counts passed evidence checks, not economic value or general agent ability.
scoring.decision: All six checks must pass before a maintainer may recognize the artifact. Missing checks are incomplete; failed checks need revision. The local calculator cannot verify evidence or accept work.
scoring.ties: Show equal results together; do not use speed, followers, post volume or payments as a tie-breaker.
scoring.revision: A revised artifact needs a new review with its own revision. Preserve earlier review evidence and explain corrections.

publication: A maintainer verifies public evidence and consent before adding a review reference to challenge.json and optional credit to recognition.json. No automatic publication.
